notes.title: Update 0.3.81
notes.notes:
This minor bug fix changes the following -

Removal of clear data button (Obsolete and broken)

Hunger now drains every 2 seconds instead of 1
Hunger now caps at 140 (Default is still 100)
Hunger no longer drops under 0

The hunger fix may require a save clear, if you are already under 0 on a save.

notes.title: New tutorial
notes.notes:
This update includes a slightly updated tutorial. 

If anyone is wanting to run through the tutorial anew, you will need to wipe your save. 
I suggest doing this manually, as the in game option is a little bugged right now.

notes.title: Bug fix + new hats
notes.notes:
Todays patch fixes a handful of bugs -

Hunger not dropping during the museum scene
Hunger not being restored by food

- Additionally several new hats have been added to find.

notes.title: Minor bug fixes + Museum
notes.notes:
A couple of known bugs have been fixed -

Hunger can no longer go under 0
Visual glitches in the museum exterior fixed

Museum Extended -
3 new rooms within the Museum added
2 information rooms
A gift shop


The gift shop isn't implemented yet
The museum has allot to be done still, but for testing purposes this early version has been released

notes.title: Patch 0.3.3
notes.notes:
With patch 0.3.3 we have added the following - 

Removed blue debug logs

Added addition of hunger
Unable to plomp if too hungry
Food will decrease hunger

notes.title: Playtest Initial Build! - Version 0.3
notes.notes:
Playtest build 0.3 is now live.

This playtest focuses on the following - 

Save/Load of equipped hats and accessories between scenes
Save/Load of equipped hats and accessories after relaunching the game
Save/Load of unlocked items

Known bugs with the save/load system - 

Music won't play until you hit save in the main menu under settings, and reload. 


For any bug reporting or feedback, please join the discord!

https://discord.gg/yXfna2sEKQ
